beats.display_text: Here's a sentence. The meeting was really productive. You read it back, and something feels off. Maybe it's the word. Maybe it's the whole sentence.
Most editors give you exactly two moves. Keep it, or delete it.
Delete it, and your first try is gone for good. Keep it, and the better version may never get written. Either way, you have to decide before you've finished thinking.
Write-on gives you a third move. Keep both.
